title: Advanced treatment of landfill leachate reverse osmosis concentrate via an integrated coagulation–sedimentation–electrochemical oxidation–biological aerated filter process

Reverse osmosis membrane filtration concentrate is a type of organic wastewater from landfill leachate treatment that has a high concentration of organic matter, refractory macromolecules, and low biodegradability.
